top_signals.title: Coinbase Posts Loss as Revenue Drops for Another Quarter
top_signals.summary: Coinbase Global Inc. reported a third consecutive quarterly decline in revenue, showing once again how a cooling crypto market can pressure even one of the industry’s most diversified exchanges.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
